title: DOSE-10060 change
description: One change to one part of one card. The changes of a market form a hash chain: each carries the hash of the one before. A change is not signed one by one; the chain is signed at its head by a checkpoint under the record key. Version 1.3, 2026-11-18.

object.description: Present on a change to a card (from version 1.3). Absent on history written before it.

field.description: The part of the card that changed (identity.name, codes.gtin, standing.status, holder ...); * for the whole card.

change.description: reissued: the card was signed again in a new shape from the values already held; not a change at the regulator. read_confirmed: a read that found versions unchanged. went_stale and holder_asserted are kept only so that history validates.

corrects.description: On corrected and restored: the event_id of the event it answers.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS form of the event without hash.
